releaseNotes:
🚀 Massive 2.7 Update!

- Dashboard redesign with live device stats, status dots, and a slim floating bottom bar
- Sleek new Lexend-font bottom-sheet dialogs for all settings
- 3 new Crosshair shapes (Gap Cross, Diamond, Triangle) with live preview
- Gorgeous new glass-style real-time Hardware Monitor overlay
- Bulletproof downloads with cancel support and smarter Shizuku setup
- Upgraded Premium login with secure on-device password hashing
- Accident-proof 'Reset All' warnings and tons of UI polish
